schema_version.description: Schema version of the report; this schema accepts version 8 [rule].

document.description: Kind of report document emitted by this schema [rule].

engine.description: Engine identity, settings, and search accounting [engine].

position.description: Summary facts about the analyzed board [rule].

selection.description: Normalized move selection and Search A coverage [rule].

opening.description: Opening-book identification for the analyzed position [book].

games.description: Game-count source summaries, without move counts [games].

moves.description: Selected move assessments in Search A order followed by asked Search C order [engine].

source.description: How the analyzed position was supplied: FEN or PGN [rule].

fen.description: Full FEN of the analyzed position [rule].

pgn_game.description: 1-based PGN game number, or null for FEN input [rule].

pgn_ply.description: Half-moves played from the game's start position, or null for FEN input [rule].

moves.description: The --moves value exactly as supplied, or null when no moves were requested [rule].

selection.description: Normalized move selection used to size Search A and choose reported moves [rule].

keywords.description: Selected keywords in the fixed enum order, each once [rule].

top.description: Largest topN selection, or null when no topN was given [rule].

moves.description: Asked move UCIs in typed order, each once [rule].

name.description: Engine name reported by UCI id name [engine].

multipv.description: MultiPV width K requested for candidate search [engine].

reproducible.description: Whether the same search configuration yields the same report [engine].

nodes.description: Configured node budget for each search kind [rule].

A.description: Scaled node budget for MultiPV K from the current position [rule].

B.description: Node budget for the null-move search with the opponent to move [rule].

C.description: Node budget for the searchmoves m search for an asked move outside A [rule].

D.description: Node budget for the search after m restricted to the opponent's threat move [rule].

E.description: Node budget for the search after m with a null move [rule].

L.description: Node budget for each threat and reply search of the tempo ledger [rule].

R.description: Node budget for the search after m excluding the refutation's first move [rule].

nodes_searched.description: Sum of nodes reported by every engine search run [engine].

fen.description: Full FEN of the analyzed board [rule].

side_to_move.description: Side to move on the analyzed board [rule].

in_check.description: Whether the side to move is in check [rule].

legal_moves.description: Number of legal moves on the analyzed board [rule].

terminal.description: Terminal state, or null when the position is nonterminal [rule].

eval_white.description: Best line evaluation from search A, from White's point of view; null iff terminal [engine].

tempo_value.description: Tempo value at the analyzed position, or null when it cannot be measured [engine].

keywords.description: Selected keywords in the fixed enum order, each once [rule].

top.description: Largest topN selection, or null when no topN was given [rule].

moves.description: Asked move UCIs in typed order, each once [rule].

lines_searched.description: MultiPV width K requested for Search A; zero for a terminal position [engine].

playable_count.description: Number of Search A lines with a best or okay verdict [engine].

playable_truncated.description: Whether Search A returned all K lines and each line was playable while K was below the legal-move count [rule].

dataset.description: Shipped opening dataset ID or custom@ plus the first 12 SHA-256 hex digits [book].

current.description: Opening name for the analyzed position, or null when unnamed [book].

last_named.description: Last named position on the PGN mainline up to the analyzed ply, or null [book].

eco.description: ECO code of the last named opening position [book].

name.description: Opening name at the last named position [book].

ply.description: Half-move number of the last named opening position [book].

by_source.description: Game-count metadata and position counts for each configured source [games].

table.description: Shipped games-table ID or custom@ plus the first 12 SHA-256 hex digits [games].

platform.description: Platform represented by the source's table [games].

players.description: Player rating criterion represented by the source's table [games].

months.description: Date range represented by the source's table [games].

credit.description: Credit and license information for the source data [games].

max_ply.description: Maximum searched half-move count in the source's table [games].

min_games.description: Minimum game count required for a move to be listed [games].

found.description: Whether the analyzed position was found in the source table [games].

games.description: Total games for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

white.description: White wins for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

draws.description: Draws for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

black.description: Black wins for the position, or null iff it was not found [games].

rank.description: 1-based MultiPV rank, or null for a move assessed by Search C [engine].

san.description: Standard algebraic notation for the move [engine].

eval.description: Score evaluation for this move from the side to move's point of view [engine].

depth.description: Search depth of the line that gave eval: the MultiPV line or Search C [engine].

loss.description: Loss from the best candidate's expected score, in [0, 1] [engine].

verdict.description: Verdict from loss, exact score equality, and whether the move allows a tactic [engine].

line.description: SAN line from the current position, starting with this move, up to 10 plies [engine].

walked_plies.description: Number of line plies from which motif and positional facts were read [rule].

line_fens.description: FEN after each walked ply in line [rule].

consequence.description: Rule-derived consequence of this move's own line from the analyzed position [rule].

is_tactic.description: Whether this move's own line has consequence class mate or material [rule].

allows_tactic.description: Whether the move loses at least one pawn net or is mated along its own line [rule].

opportunity.description: Opportunity judgement for a line that has one, or null [engine/rule].

motifs.description: Move-line motifs whose contribution is direct or indirect [rule].

root_motifs.description: Root motifs whose contribution is direct or indirect for this move line [rule].

tactic_labels.description: Rule-derived labels for this tactic line; empty otherwise [rule].

positional.description: Positional changes with net_change and in_use true, ordered by §6.7 positional impact order [rule].

tempo_value.description: Tempo value after this move, or null when search E did not run [engine].

tempo_gained.description: Tempo-gaining plies from the ledger, or null iff no ledger [engine].

initiative.description: Initiative runs from the ledger, or null iff no ledger [rule].

impact_order.description: Non-empty impact groups, sorted by rule-derived rank [rule].

parried_threat.description: Opponent threat and parry test when the move parries that threat, or null [engine/rule].

threat.description: Opponent's threat line and consequence, without its motifs or tactic judgements [engine/rule].

test.description: How parrying the opponent's threat was tested [engine/rule].

created_threat.description: Threat created by this move when its consequence is mate, material or promotion, without motifs; otherwise null [engine/rule].

refutation.description: Opponent's refutation when the move is not playable, with relevant motifs only [engine/rule].

games.description: Number of source games that played this move [games].

root_fen.description: FEN at the root of the threat search [engine].

line.description: SAN moves in the engine's threat line [engine].

consequence.description: Rule-derived consequence of the threat line [rule].

motifs.description: Tactical motifs in the threat line [rule].

is_tactic.description: Whether the refuted move allows a tactic; null except for a refutation [rule].

opportunity.description: Opportunity judgement for a judged threat line, or null [engine/rule].

tactic_labels.description: Rule-derived labels for a tactic threat line; empty otherwise [rule].

es.description: Expected score from the side named by the containing field [engine].

cp.description: Centipawn display score, or null when unavailable [engine].

mate.description: Mate distance in moves, or null when the evaluation is not a mate score [engine].

mate_in.description: Mate distance in plies, set iff class is mate [rule].

material.description: Net material gain in pawn units for the threatening side over plies [rule].

promotes.description: Whether the threatening side promotes within the consequence line [rule].

plies.description: Number of threat-line plies consumed by the consequence rule [rule].

source.description: Provenance of the opportunity judgement: engine, or rule iff the line is forced [engine/rule].

forced.description: Whether the judged line's root has exactly one legal move [rule].

alternative.description: Best alternative first move, or null iff the line is forced [engine].

san.description: Standard algebraic notation for the alternative move [engine].

uci.description: UCI encoding of the alternative move [engine].

eval.description: Expected-score evaluation of the alternative from the judged line's side point of view [engine].

margin.description: Expected-score margin of the line over its best alternative, or null iff forced [engine].

is_opportunity.description: Whether the judged line meets the opportunity margin [engine].

side.description: Side that benefits from this motif [rule].

ply.description: Ply at which the motif is present, zero for the root position [rule].

actor.description: Piece that acts in the motif [rule].

targets.description: Pieces targeted by this motif in its defined order [rule].

gain.description: Static-exchange gain in pawn units when defined for this motif [rule].

threat.description: Threat associated with a tactical pin, or null [rule].

restriction.description: Restricted piece and its move set when defined for this motif [rule].

contribution.description: Motif's role in the tactic, or null when not judged [rule].

also.description: Other labels merged into this restricted-movement motif, in source list order [rule].

threat.description: Threat associated with an additional tactical pin label, or null [rule].

square.description: Square where the threat would originate [rule].

piece.description: Restricted piece as placed on the motif board [rule].

restricted.description: Denied move UCIs in ascending order [rule].

free.description: Other legal move UCIs in ascending order [rule].

held_to.description: Geometric description of the held piece's restricted destinations [rule].

name.description: Square, file, rank or destination set name [rule].

actor.description: Capturing piece on its destination square [rule].

targets.description: Captured defender followed by the piece it defended [rule].

side.description: Side whose tempo value is reported [engine].

moves.description: Expected score for the side when it moves [engine].

passes.description: Expected score for the side when it passes [engine].

value.description: Expected-score difference between moving and passing [engine].

label.description: Tempo label for the value, or null in the unlabelled interval [rule].

ply.description: Ply on which a tempo was gained [engine].

start_ply.description: First tempo-gaining ply of the run [rule].

end_ply.description: Last ply included in the run [rule].

tempi.description: Number of tempi gained by the holder during the run [rule].

ending.description: Rule-derived ending of the initiative run [rule].

outcome.description: Whether a run's gain is converted or evaporated [rule].

impact_group.description: Move-report group name, in §6.7 base order and rank sorting [rule].

ply.description: Ply at which the feature appeared or disappeared [rule].

change.description: Whether the feature appeared or disappeared [rule].

holds_at_end.description: Whether the change's feature identity has this final state at the end of the analyzed line [rule].

net_change.description: Whether this is the last change of a feature that differs from the root [rule].

in_use.description: Whether a net positional change passes the use test, or null when it is not net [rule].

side.description: Side that owns or benefits from the positional feature [rule].

pieces.description: Pieces participating in the feature, in its defined order [rule].

file.description: File associated with the feature, or null when not defined [rule].

value.description: Numeric feature value when defined, or null [rule].

piece.description: FEN piece letter on the square [rule].

eco.description: ECO code of the opening name [book].
